Ergonomically-designed pointing trowel with a soft-grip handle for additional comfort and control whilst working. Features carbon steel blade and finger guard. End cap allows tamping without damaging bricks. Tapered blade gives trowel greater flexibility and makes it ideal for mixing mortar, pointing and small repair jobs. Pointed end ensures neatly finished mortar joints.
